items.title: Network Security
items.description: Network security fundamentals for software engineers — firewalls, VPNs, network segmentation, DDoS mitigation, DNS security, zero trust networking, mTLS, and cloud network controls.

items.title: Proxies, Firewalls, NAT & VPNs
items.description: Deep dive into network middleboxes, forward and reverse proxies, Linux Netfilter hooks, conntrack state machine, WireGuard vs IPsec VPN encapsulation, and MSS clamping.

items.title: Tor, Onion Routing & Privacy Networks
items.description: Senior deep dive into Tor onion routing, 3-hop circuit telescoping, cell peeling cryptography, V3 hidden services, traffic correlation attacks, and Tor vs VPN vs Proxy comparison.
